import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    c4=np.cos(0.4*t); s4=np.sin(0.4*t)
    return (params[0]*np.exp(-v)+params[1]*np.exp(-x)*t+params[2]*np.cos(v)*c4+params[3]*np.sin(v)*s4
            +params[4]*v**3*t+params[5]*np.sin(x)+params[6]*np.sin(v)+params[7]*np.tanh(v)
            +params[8]*v**3+params[9]*np.cos(x)*t)
